newsitem.title: FRANCE: Markets should be calm on deficit - Strauss-Kahn.
newsitem.headline: Markets should be calm on deficit - Strauss-Kahn.

text.p: French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said on Thursday financial markets should not be concerned about figures for the French 1997 deficit published in various newspaper reports.
"Growth is returning in a stronger way than we thought a few weeks ago. Therefore there is no reason for the markets to be worried," he told reporters after a cabinet meeting.
"There's nothing new about budget slippages...Figures have appeared in the press but there's nothing new. What's possible (regarding the deficits) is already known," he also said.
